Visual Identity & Logo Direction

The logo concept is the Jingzhang Knot: a vertical warp and a horizontal weft interlace into a knot with a diamond node, evoking rail switches, loom weaving and chip grids. Built on an 8x8 grid with an I-beam rail section in the negative space; a concept direction for professional refinement.

Three Industry Testbeds

Safety governance sandbox

Model safety evaluation and red-teaming; voluntary admission; isolated network; public summaries

Edge computing station

Low-latency inference and device integration; standard racks; six-month load and energy measurement

Data-element salon

Compliant data circulation pilot; provenance review, anonymization, full audit trail

All scenarios honor the taskbook rules: no non-public data, no named vendors, never described as approved operations; each card has human review and pilot validation methods.

Renewal Projects

Renewal is organized as stitch, weave, belt: first heal the railway severance, then weave the urban fabric, finally form the innovation belt.

Stitch

Continuous Jingzhang heritage park heals pedestrian and slow-traffic breaks.

Weave

Four meridian corridors: west renewal wing, Jingzhang green spine, central innovation column, east reserve wing.

Belt

Three key areas anchor innovation functions and upgrade consumption along the belt.

Centenary Jingzhang Cultural Narrativeagent.5

Taskbook agent.5 requires the railway historical-resource system, Zhongguancun and AI new-culture narrative, spatial carriers, wayfinding symbols and international communication. The timeline below is a publicly verifiable factual base.

  • 1905-1909 Jingzhang Railway completed: first trunk line designed and built by Chinese engineers, Zhan Tianji's zigzag line
  • 2019 Beijing-Zhangjiakou HSR opens: 350 km/h, world's first automated-driving high-speed railway, 56-minute trip
  • 2023 Heritage park Phase 1 opens: 2.4 km from Qinghua East Road to Zhichun Road, 16.8 ha of new green space
  • 2026 Phase 2 fully opens: ~9 km total, continuous slow-traffic system, community-vitality south and nature-leisure north

Three-Layer Heritage System

  • Engineering layer Linear embankment, switch remains, station houses
  • Memory layer 1909 self-built line to 2019 automated HSR
  • Living layer Everyday use of the heritage park

The narrative theme is From Rails to Algorithms: the railway proved China could master complex systems engineering, Zhongguancun proved indigenous industrialization, and the AI belt must prove autonomous intelligence and urban life can coexist. Slogan: The AI Belt Woven on a Century-Old Railway. Wayfinding uses warp-weft coordinate codes (JZ-warp x weft).

All facts are registered in sources.json (JINGZHANG-RAILWAY-HISTORY / JINGZHANG-HSR / JINGZHANG-PARK / ZHONGGUANCUN-HISTORY); the symbol system is a concept direction, syntactically consistent with but independent of the overall logo.

Assumptions

A-CONTROLS-001 pending_professional_confirmation

Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.

The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

A-KEYAREA-PROV-001 pending_professional_confirmation

The three key detailed-design areas (zhongzhiyuan_ai_acceleration_area, beijing_ai_origin_community, dazhongsi_ai_industry_cluster) are drawn as provisional constraint envelopes announced publicly; official redlines and precise areas are not included in the public site package.

Key-area geometry is used only to structure design intensity and narrative focus; it must not be read as an official redline or precise-area basis.

A-FAR-MISSING-001 pending_professional_confirmation

Approved FAR / floor-area controls are absent from the public package, so total floor area and floor_area_ratio are reported as unknown in metrics.json.

No FAR-dependent claim is asserted anywhere in the submission; building floors are suggestions only.

A-BLDG-SUGGEST-001 pending_professional_confirmation

All 21 building footprints, their suggested floor counts, and renovation/retain/new actions are AI-generated massing suggestions with low confidence.

Building layer supports scenario storytelling only and must be replaced by survey-based footprints before any engineering use.

A-PHASE-YEARS-001 pending_professional_confirmation

Phase years 2026-2028 / 2028-2032 / 2032-2045 and the south-to-north stitching order are indicative planning assumptions, not committed schedules.

Phasing polygons quantify proposal areas per stage; timing claims should be re-validated against official implementation plans.

A-ROAD-CL-001 pending_professional_confirmation

Road centerlines are indicative alignment proposals clipped to the site boundary; geodesic lengths are declared but lane counts and cross-sections are not designed.

Roads layer is for network-structure review only; statutory road redlines remain under official control (see A-CONTROLS-001).
